description.en: A smooth, lemony soup that comes together in one pot.
description.ro: O supă cremoasă cu lămâie, gătită într-o singură oală.
description.ar: شوربة ناعمة بالليمون تُطهى في قدر واحد.

steps: Soften the onion, carrots and garlic in the oil for 5 minutes.
Stir in the cumin, then add the lentils and the stock.
Bring to the boil, then simmer for 20 minutes until the lentils collapse.
Blend until smooth, stir in the lemon juice and season to taste.
